subject.title: Cross-domain obligations and selective semantic invalidation

objective: Make accepted BA output create authorized SA obligations and make upstream semantic changes stale only the exact reverse-dependent claims/obligations/work, without hidden dispatch or stage resets.
architectureDecisions: CrossDomainObligation states WHAT another domain owes; it is never a dispatch command
source domain cannot choose target worker, strategy, runtime or priority
only accepted lineage from DomainPublicationReceipt enters product dependency truth
dependency invalidation follows exact semantic subjects and reverse transitive closure, not artifact containers/stages
semantic claim/obligation payloads are immutable; currentness lives in separate heads/transitions
precision comes from stable RequirementClaim/AcceptanceCriterion/etc subject keys and exact assertion refs
downstream publication uses pre/post input-currentness handshake so upstream invalidation cannot miss a racing new edge
historical claims remain reconstructable after becoming STALE/REVOKED/SUPERSEDED

requirements: separate from claim authority and ExecutionPolicy
explicit publish artifact/claim kinds, obligation kinds, allowed target domains/workload types and forbidden mutations

implementationSlices.output: immutable SemanticClaim + SemanticClaimHead/currentness transitions and immutable CrossDomainObligation + ObligationHead
requirements: same normalized obligation payload replays to same revision/ref
semantic change creates new superseding revision; old payload is never mutated
target verifies issuance receipt, historical authority and current obligation/input subjects
introduce ORGANIZATION_WORK_CONTRACT v2 for cross-domain materialization if needed to bind sourceObligationRef/key/head generation; preserve v1 interpretation/compatibility
source domain never calls target DomainExecutionController

implementationSlices.output: authoritative ProductDerivationEdge persistence + deterministic DependencyImpactAnalysis + currentness transition/reconciliation
requirements: impact analysis is derived proposal state; mutation uses exact CAS/currentness authority
reverse dependent closure invalidates only affected semantic claims/obligations
RequirementSet publishes stable RequirementClaim and acceptance-criterion subjects
typed SOLUTION_DESIGN_REQUIRED obligation materializes SA-owned work
SA executes through BB-048 execution-control semantics and publishes ArchitecturePackage/ArchitectureClaim refs
SA may issue only allowed FE/BE/DevOps obligation kinds under DomainWriteAuthority

hardInvariants: Board dependency DAG != product semantic lineage
claim authority != execution policy != domain write authority
historical claim validity != currentness for new mutation
no LLM semantic guess may prune required invalidation in v1
acceptanceCriteria: accepted BA RequirementClaim can issue one authorized SOLUTION_DESIGN_REQUIRED obligation and deterministically materialize SA work
SA execution publishes ArchitectureClaim/interface subjects and only authorized downstream obligation kinds
REQ-DETAIL revision change stales only ARCH-DETAIL and dependent FE-DETAIL while REQ-LIST/ARCH-LIST/BE-LIST/FE-LIST remain current
downstream publication racing upstream supersession cannot leave a silently-current new dependent edge
claimed work made stale uses canonical organization-claim invalidation/release fencing, not direct Board mutation
impact/projection caches are rebuildable from immutable claims/heads/transitions
mandatoryNegativeTests: source domain selects target ExecutionStrategy/worker/runtime in obligation
unsupported obligation kind/target domain/workload is published
RequirementSet container revision stales unrelated semantic subjects
impact analysis computed at head H1 commits against changed H2
history is rewritten in place on supersession
race between new dependency publication and upstream invalidation escapes currentness reconciliation

activation.baselinePolicy: Resolve the exact current source baseline at allocation time and bind both semanticInputRef and this implementation spec from current.json. Do not reuse the origin planning baseline.
